description: Canonical Ukrainian civil shelter data schema. AI maps source fields to these PropertyNames. Derived from Kyiv City ArcGIS data (golden reference, ~80% completeness). Update this file as new fields become standard.

system_fields.name: Oblast
system_fields.description: Region name. Always injected by the orchestrator from the oblast folder, never from source data.

system_fields.name: City
system_fields.description: City or hromada name. Injected by orchestrator from the hromada folder.

system_fields.name: DataSource
system_fields.description: Source URL for traceability. Injected by orchestrator.

fields.name: District
fields.description: Administrative district within a city or oblast

fields.name: ShelterType
fields.description: Primary classification of the shelter (legal/regulatory category)

fields.name: ShelterKind
fields.description: Physical sub-type of the shelter space

fields.name: BuildingType
fields.description: Type of building hosting the shelter

fields.name: Capacity
fields.description: Number of people the shelter can hold

fields.name: DisabledAccess
fields.description: Accessibility features for persons with disabilities
